id.description: The unique UUID for the Sender.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the transaction's currency.

additional_information.description: Any additional information for the transaction, e.g. addtional sender details or transaction and client references.

sender.description: Sender details - the format is "sender":"name; address; country; account_number or iban; bic; routing_code"

receiving_account_number.description: The account number that received the funds.

receiving_account_iban.description: The IBAN number for the account that received the funds.

created_at.description: The transaction date and time of creation.

updated_at.description: The transaction date and time of the last update.
